summary: Iteration 5 covers the three new features end-to-end. Backend pytest: 32/32 passed against the public preview (edit applicant PATCH admin+office / 403 reviewer+lecturer / 400 empty body / 404 unknown; delete DELETE admin only / 403 office+reviewer+lecturer / 404 unknown / GET-verified removal; CSV import admin only + 403 for others + created=2/skipped=0/errors=2 shape + duplicate run skipped=2 + GET verification; document upload for all 4 roles round-trips through Emergent Object Storage - Identity proof/Mark sheets/Transfer certificate/Fee receipt - and the returned bytes match; download 200 via ?token=, 401 for missing+bad token, 404 when no file exists; invalid document name 400; unknown applicant 404; plus regression on dashboard/applicants/courses/staff/reports). Frontend mobile (390x844): admin Applications tab shows Import button, bulk-import modal accepts pasted CSV and the two rows appear in the list; edit-applicant-button opens the edit form and Save updates the record (visible in list after search); delete-applicant-button shows confirm-delete-card and Confirm removes the applicant; office role sees Edit + Upload icons but not Delete/Import; reviewer role hides Import, Edit and Delete. RBAC gating for reviewer previously confirmed in-run.

issues: Header icon buttons (edit-applicant-button, delete-applicant-button, close-detail-button) render inside a horizontally scrollable header row; on RN Web they can report boundingBox with y just above viewport 0 which trips Playwright default click actionability. Clicking still works via native tap on device and via JS click in tests; not a real user bug but worth normalising header layout for cleaner testability.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning repeats on every open: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' - a stray string child (likely a template literal that resolves to '' or a space between JSX siblings inside a <View>) is being rendered. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.
Still emitting 'shadow* style props are deprecated (use boxShadow)' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)' - carried over from iteration 4.

action_items: Investigate the 'Unexpected text node' warning in the applicant detail modal (likely a bare string/whitespace child inside a <View> in modals.tsx). Wrap in <Text> or remove.
Optional polish: migrate legacy shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web dev warnings.
Consider clearing React Query cache on signOut to avoid the transient 401 request logged immediately after role switch.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py edit_applicant correctly returns 400 when the PATCH body is empty (before hitting the DB) and 404 when the applicant is missing - matches contract.
import_applicants normalises header casing/spacing, validates required columns, and reports created/skipped/errors[:20] - safe against very large CSVs.
upload_document validates document name against DOCUMENTS whitelist, checks applicant existence before storage put, enforces 15 MB limit, and returns storage 402 as HTTP 402 with a clear message.
download_document accepts both ?token= and Authorization: Bearer, decodes JWT once, and returns raw bytes with content-type - clean.
clean(_) helper is applied consistently so MongoDB _id never leaks - re-verified in tests.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on flows exercised (admin import, admin edit, admin delete, doc upload/view icons render, RBAC for reviewer + office)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created transient TEST_ applicants (APP-TEST-EDIT-*, APP-TEST-DEL-*, APP-TEST-DOC-*, APP-TEST-NOFILE-*, APP-TEST-IMP-*-{1,2}) and cleaned them up in teardown_class. Frontend Playwright created APP-UI-{stamp}-1/-2, edited -1 and deleted both at end-of-run. No lingering test data expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview: https://mvp-to-app-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Auth via /api/auth/login (application/x-www-form-urlencoded, field 'username'). For UI: on RN Web the applicant detail header buttons (edit-applicant-button, delete-applicant-button, close-detail-button) and the Import modal's run-import-button can report 'outside of viewport' to Playwright even at 390x844; use el.evaluate('e => e.click()') instead of force click. Detail modal is a sheet that stays mounted; scope searches with the 'application-search-input' before opening a row. New testIDs added this round: import-button, close-import-button, csv-paste-input, pick-csv-button, run-import-button, edit-applicant-button, delete-applicant-button, confirm-delete-card, cancel-delete-button, confirm-delete-button, edit-first_name-input, edit-last_name-input, edit-mobile-input, edit-email-input, edit-fee-input, save-edit-button, close-edit-button, upload-doc-<slug>, view-doc-<slug>. File download uses GET /api/files/{app_no}/{doc}?token=<JWT>. Uploads go through /api/applicants/{app_no}/documents/upload (multipart form field 'document' + 'file').
rca_of_issue: No product bugs found. The only script-level hiccup was Playwright's actionability check flagging some in-modal buttons as 'outside of viewport' even with force=True; the fix was to dispatch a JS click via element.evaluate. All backend flows return correct status codes, persist correctly, and enforce RBAC as specified.
